mapper.sql: select id, prop_id, prop_name, total_score, total_diamonds, total_ticket, current_diamonds, before_ticket, from_user_id, p_user_id, p_user_name, to_user_id, FROM_UNIXTIME(create_time) create_time , create_date, create_y, create_m, create_d, create_w, num, video_id, group_id, is_red_envelope, msg, ActionStatus, ErrorInfo, ErrorCode, create_ym, is_private, from_ip, is_coin from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop
mapper.select: select id, prop_id, prop_name, total_diamonds, current_diamonds, p_user_id, to_user_id, create_time from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop where create_time >= #{start} and create_time <= #{end}
select IFNULL(SUM(total_ticket),0) from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop where to_user_id = #{userId} and create_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{beginTime})) and create_time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW())
select IFNULL(SUM(total_ticket),0) from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop where to_user_id = #{userId} and create_date = #{dayTime}

select to_user_id hostId, IFNULL(SUM(total_ticket),0) sumHostProp from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop where to_user_id > 0 and p_user_id not in (select id from ${dbMain}.member_info where status in (2,0)) and create_date = #{dayTime} GROUP BY to_user_id

select to_user_id hostId, IFNULL(SUM(total_ticket),0) sumHostProp from 7706_live.live_video_prop where to_user_id > 0 and p_user_id not in (select id from 7706_main.member_info where status in (2,0)) and create_date = #{dayTime} GROUP BY to_user_id

select anchor hostId ,IFNULL(SUM(cost),0) sumHostProp from ${dbLottery}.lottery_bet_bb_view where update_time >= #{begin} and update_time <= #{end} and anchor >0 and puser_id not in (select id from ${dbMain}.member_info where status in (2,0)) GROUP BY anchor
